occurrences.text: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
